description:
Add a public Session.compact/1 (and Session.compact/2 with opts) API for
user- or extension-triggered manual compaction.

Reference: tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/agent-session.ts lines 1605-1733.

Depends on: Compaction module, overflow/auto-compaction ticket (for the shared
event emission pattern and is_compacting? flag).

## Public API to add in apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/session.ex

  @doc """
  Manually trigger context compaction. Returns :ok immediately; compaction runs
  asynchronously. Emits CompactionStart then CompactionEnd when done.
  Options:
    keep_recent_tokens: integer (default 8000)
    model: OctoPi.AI.Model.t() (override model for summarization, default session model)
  """
  def compact(pid, opts \\ [])

## GenServer handle_call(:compact, ...)

  1. If state.is_streaming?, return {:reply, {:error, :streaming}, state} — cannot
     compact mid-turn.
  2. If state.is_compacting?, return {:reply, {:error, :already_compacting}, state}.
  3. Set is_compacting?: true in state.
  4. Emit CompactionStart{reason: :manual} via Subscribers.dispatch.
  5. Start a Task under OctoPi.Agent.LoopSupervisor to run:
       Compaction.compact(state.session_manager, state.transport,
                          opts[:model] || state.model,
                          keep_recent_tokens: opts[:keep_recent_tokens] || 8000)
  6. Store the Task ref in state.compaction_abort_ref.
  7. Return {:reply, :ok, updated_state}.

## Task completion

In handle_info({ref, result}, state) for completed compaction task:
  On {:ok, compaction_result}:
    - SessionManager.append_compaction -> updated sm
    - Set is_compacting?: false, clear compaction_abort_ref
    - Emit CompactionEnd{reason: :manual, result: compaction_result}
    - Drain compaction_queue (re-process any prompt calls that arrived during compaction)
    - Return {:noreply, %{state | session_manager: updated_sm, ...}}
  On {:error, reason} or Task exit:
    - Set is_compacting?: false, clear compaction_abort_ref
    - Emit CompactionEnd{reason: :manual, aborted?: true, error_message: inspect(reason)}
    - Drain compaction_queue
    - Return {:noreply, updated_state}

## Abort during manual compaction

In the existing abort/1 handler, if state.compaction_abort_ref is set:
  AbortRef.abort(state.compaction_abort_ref) to signal the Task.
  Also Task.shutdown the task process.

## Tests

Create apps/octo_pi_agent/test/octo_pi/agent/session_compaction_test.exs.
Port from tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/test/agent-session-compaction.test.ts.
Cover:
  - compact/1 returns {:error, :streaming} when a run is in progress
  - CompactionStart{reason: :manual} fires before the LLM call
  - CompactionEnd{reason: :manual} fires after
  - CompactionEntry is present in session_manager.entries after completion
  - build_session_context uses the compaction summary on the next prompt
  - abort/1 during compaction emits CompactionEnd{aborted?: true}
title: Manual compaction API in Session
